metrics.metric: Market capitalization milestones (2018 CEO Performance Award)
metrics.evidence: market capitalization milestone for such tranche, which begins at $100 billion for the first tranche and increases by increments of $50 billion thereafter

metrics.metric: Total Revenue operational milestones (2018 CEO Performance Award)
metrics.evidence: any one of the following 8 operational milestones focused on revenue or 8 operational milestones focused on profitability

metrics.metric: Adjusted EBITDA operational milestones (2018 CEO Performance Award)
metrics.evidence: any one of the following 8 operational milestones focused on revenue or 8 operational milestones focused on profitability

metrics.metric: Market capitalization increase milestones (2012 CEO Performance Award)
metrics.evidence: a sustained incremental $4 billion increase in Tesla's market capitalization from $3.2 billion

metrics.metric: Model X or Model 3 development operational milestone (2012 CEO Performance Award)
metrics.evidence: a specified operational milestone relating to development of Model X or Model 3, aggregate vehicle production or a gross margin target

metrics.metric: Aggregate vehicle production operational milestone (2012 CEO Performance Award)
metrics.evidence: a specified operational milestone relating to development of Model X or Model 3, aggregate vehicle production or a gross margin target

metrics.metric: Gross margin target operational milestone (2012 CEO Performance Award)
metrics.evidence: requiring that Tesla achieve gross margin of 30% or more for four consecutive quarters
